scenes.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve / illustration-story. Create ONE PRODUCTION ANIMATION SPRITE STRIP, EXACTLY 2048x768 pixels: 2 equal 1024x768 4:3 animation cels side by side, ONE row, no gutters/borders. Preserve equal cel dimensions and clear vertical cel boundaries. Consecutive articulated character poses: do NOT fake action by sliding/zooming a whole static illustration. Same-location actions MUST use identical background, camera distance, character size and placement; only limbs, hands, expressions and contacted props change. Travel/entry across locations may change environment deliberately to show the narrated progression. Original reference image is assets/images/stories/saying_no.png. IDENTITY LOCK: Protagonist is the GIRL, not the boy from the other stories: long dark brown hair with bangs, large brown eyes, warm peach skin, rosy round cheeks, pink collared short-sleeve shirt. Supporting adult is partly visible in blue. Preserve the girl's face and hairstyle; do not replace her with a boy. Narration for context, never print words: We can use a kind voice. We can shake our head or say, 'No, thank you.' Required location(s): home indoor room. Emotion: kind, calm. Props/contact: offered item kept away from girl. LEFT FRAME: Original girl in pink gently turns head a little left while raised palm says no kindly. RIGHT FRAME: Same girl turns head a little right, same calm mouth and raised palm; adult keeps offered item at distance. Show ALL narrated beats in this ordered strip, each cel a distinct meaningful action pose. Use exact reference faces, hair, eye shape, skin, clothes, proportions and warm premium 2D children's cartoon rendering. Full uncropped heads with visible space ABOVE hair and around all active hands/props in EVERY frame; 10% safe margin around heads. Full body and feet visible for walking/sitting/standing actions. Keep hands anatomically coherent and props held or supported correctly. No text, speech bubbles, labels, numbers, watermark or logos. For toilet scenes conceal all private anatomy behind privacy partition or non-explicit clothing, never draw nudity. For roads child remains behind curb until adult checks safe crossing; never step into road on red pedestrian light. For personal space never hug or touch without consent. Asset id: saying_no-p2. Continuity and framing: the original GIRL always wears the same pink collared short-sleeve polo, blue denim SHORTS and pink sneakers across every cel; no trousers/jeans and no boy replacing her. Show her entire hair silhouette, both hands, and both shoes with at least 50px clear background around her. Use a wider camera. Any supporting friend is distinct from the pink-shirt girl. Preserve original face and gentle cartoon style.
